build_launch_server_cmd: build a function to launch the sglang server with a given command, auto-reserving a free port and applying memory-limiting flags
create_patched_post_init: create a patched __post_init__ method for ServerArgs that sets default max_running_requests and max_total_tokens and disables CUDA graphs
run_reserve_port: run reserve_port from sglang.utils to allocate and lock a free TCP port on a given host
test_execute_shell_command: test execute_shell_command from sglang.utils to run the full server launch command string in a subprocess
review_process_socket_map: review the process_socket_map WeakKeyDictionary that tracks launched server processes to their reserved lock sockets for cleanup
